description: Ambuja Cements reported a profit drop, impacted by lower sales volume and higher costs. The company will now prioritize value over sales volume in its operations. Ambuja Cements remains confident of outpacing industry growth for the remainder of the fiscal.

title: Hyundai India Q1 profit misses estimates, drops 35% on disruptions
description: Hyundai Motor India reported a 35% decline in Q1 net profit, missing estimates as production disruptions and weaker Middle East exports hurt earnings. The company expects recovery from Q2 with production normalisation, new vehicle launches and Rs 7,500 crore planned capital expenditure.

title: Torrent Pharmaceuticals Q1 Results: Profit rises 3% to Rs 566 crore
description: Torrent Pharmaceuticals announced a robust profit after tax of Rs 566 crore for the first quarter, showcasing impressive growth. Revenue soared to Rs 4,921 crore, with Indian revenue up by nineteen percent and a significant thirty-six percent increase in US revenue. Meanwhile, Germany and Brazil experiences growth of three and twenty-seven percent, respectively. The strong financial performance reflects the success of new launches and market opportunities.

title: Bank of England policymakers keep rates on hold but more back hike
description: The Bank of England decided to keep its benchmark interest rate steady at 3.75 percent. However, three policymakers have pushed for a possible hike amid rising tensions in the Middle East. With inflation expected to touch 3.2 percent later this year, projections indicate that rates will stay above target until early 2028. Thus, the central bank is adopting a cautious, wait-and-see strategy.

title: UK bond yields and sterling dip after BoE holds rates steady
description: In a move consistent with expectations, the Bank of England has kept interest rates steady at 3.75 percent. They noted domestic conditions are helping to alleviate inflationary pressures. Following this update, there were minor decreases in UK bond yields and the pound. Inflation is anticipated to climb to 3.2 percent later this year while the FTSE 100 stock index saw an uptick on Thursday.

title: Quote of the day by Marty Whitman: "We’re bottom-up investors. We always have to operate on negative macro assumptions"
description: Legendary investor Marty Whitman advocated a bottom-up investing approach, urging investors to assume adverse macro conditions while focusing on strong businesses. He emphasised resilient balance sheets, capable management, competitive advantages and attractive valuations to generate long-term returns despite economic uncertainty.

title: India bonds slip on Fed uncertainty, war worries
description: On Thursday, Indian government bonds faced a decline for the third consecutive day. The rise in U.S. Treasury yields dampened enthusiasm for Indian debt instruments, while escalating geopolitical tensions from the Gulf region further affected market dynamics. Additionally, concerns about the Federal Reserve's ambiguous interest rate plans placed additional strain on bond prices. Nevertheless, measures from the Reserve Bank of India, which facilitated dollar inflows, offered some respite.
